answer.rationale: Finance mandate of 18% cost reduction is incompatible with incumbent's refusal to reopen pricing (memory_c4 shows renegotiation is possible but only under threat of change). Memory_c2 demonstrates a low-cost vendor can onboard quickly with accurate invoicing. The 14-day timeline requires immediate action. Assembly line at 94% capacity means single-source risk is acute. A standard experiment with a second low-cost vendor addresses the cost imperative while memory_c3 shows multi-source reduces allocation risk during constraints. Verifying memory_c2 confirms the low-cost transition pathway is repeatable. This is not a full switch yet—it's a parallel test that forces the incumbent's hand on pricing while protecting delivery. If the new vendor fails to meet cost+quality targets, we defer to month-to-month on incumbent and revisit at next cycle.
